stem:
Esha draws rectangle $PQRS$ with diagonal $PR$. Triangle $PQR$ uses three corners of the rectangle.

Which claim about the areas is correct?

options.text: Triangle $PQR$ has half the area of rectangle $PQRS$.
The area of triangle $PQR$ equals the length of diagonal $PR$.
Rectangle $PQRS$ has half the area of triangle $PQR$.
Triangle $PQR$ and rectangle $PQRS$ have the same area.

teacher.key_rationale: A diagonal splits a rectangle into two equal-area triangles, so triangle PQR has half the area of rectangle PQRS.
